label: granquad-half
_why: THE CORRECTED GRANULARITY ARM, HALF SPAN (user-ruled 2026-08-21: 'go with a 1836-1886 run under the proposed ladder, exactly half the game span'). F78 found that making every tiered building a 1/5 economic unit shrank the tiered sector to 0.39x capacity and world GDP to 0.47x, because `ai_value` is scored PER BUILDING and the building's SIZE is nowhere in that comparison — so a 1/5 building bought a fifth as much economy for the same desire. This arm pairs the same 1/5 unit with the QUADRATIC ai_value ladder, which restores and then some. ARM: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.granquad.json} - full modded build, no overlay, no control. SPAN 1836.1.1 -> 1886.1.1, n=1.
_the_ladder: config/mod_config.granquad.json = config/mod_config.granular.json + `ai_value = 1000 x (era+1)^2`. Differs from the granular arm by exactly 105 values, ALL `tiers[].ai_value` (verified by explicit path diff). sha256 760D6377B92DAF3B. In FIELD-EQUIVALENT terms — economy delivered per unit of desire, against the 75 untiered vanilla buildings sitting at the engine default 1000 (F76) — the rungs read **0.2 / 0.8 / 1.8 / 3.2 / 5.0 / 7.2x**. So e0 is well BELOW a wheat farm, e1 slightly below, and e2 upward above it, with a top rung near aival2's 6x, which is the best-performing setting measured so far. Neither previous ladder did that: aival2 left e0 AT the field and the full-size quadratic left it at the field while overshooting the top to 36x.
_prediction_registered_before_the_run: ⚠⚠ DIRECTIONAL ONLY, AND DELIBERATELY NOT A TARGET VALUE. The obvious phrasing — 'if ai_value is the whole story, tier capacity returns to ~1.0x canon' — is a ceteris-paribus error and the user caught it twice. The corrected arm diverges from turn one: a different early construction mix gives a different GDP, hence different investment and tax revenue, hence different construction, hence different research funding and therefore a different set of tiers existing at all. There is NO reason the ratio must land on 1.0 even if ai_value fully explains the earlier gap; the system can settle anywhere. WHAT IS PREDICTED: tier building-equivalent capacity relative to canon-n7 should be MATERIALLY ABOVE the granular arm's trajectory (0.891x at 1850, 0.811x at 1860, 0.712x at 1870, 0.733x at 1880). WHAT WOULD BE INFORMATIVE EITHER WAY: landing at or above canon says the devaluation was the whole of F78; landing between granular and canon says the multiplier undoes part of it and a feedback path carries the rest; landing at or below granular says ai_value does not compensate for unit size at all and the granularity idea needs a different lever.
_why_this_span_is_enough: MEASURED, not assumed. The granular-vs-canon gap opens early and canon-n7's run-to-run spread is tiny early, so the signal-to-noise is best well before 1886: at 1850 the gap is 11% against a canon cv of 0.7% (~15x), at 1860 19% against 0.6% (~30x), at 1870 29% against 2.2% (~13x), at 1880 27% against 4.8% (~6x). World GDP agrees more coarsely (13% below at 1880 against a 4.3% cv). ⇒ n=1 settles this comfortably; an ensemble is not needed at this magnitude, and the four checkpoints make it a TRAJECTORY rather than a point. ⚠ THE SHARP INSTRUMENT IS TIER BUILDING-EQUIVALENTS (levels x workforce_mult), NOT LEVELS — a granular level is a fifth of a building, so raw level counts are not comparable across these arms at all.
_arms: granquad = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.granquad.json}, PAIRED with config/tech_tree_options.granquad.json (landmine L20). Chain of derivation: canonical config -> granular (goods/cost /5 explicitly, employment via workforce_mult 0.2, pollution/infrastructure/ship_construction via effect_mult 0.2, all 105 tiers verified to exactly 1/5) -> granquad (+ quadratic ai_value). THE FREEZE IS LANDMINE L10; no build-path file may be touched for the duration. NO CONTROL ARM, by standing user ruling.
_comparison: PRIMARY: the granular arm (20260820_224325, n=2, 1.13.11, same machine) at MATCHED DATES — the only difference is ai_value, so this is a clean same-patch A/B on the correction itself. SECONDARY: canon-n7 (20260818_221216, n=6) as the full-size no-ladder reference, at matched dates, with the 1.13.10 patch caveat. ⚠ DO NOT compare 1886 figures against any arm's 1935 figures; every ratio here must be read at the same year.
_watch: (1) TIER BUILDING-EQUIVALENTS ÷ canon-n7 at 1850/1860/1870/1880, against the granular arm's 0.891 / 0.811 / 0.712 / 0.733. This is the headline and the reason for the run. (2) World GDP ÷ canon at the same dates (granular: 0.935 / 0.902 / 0.873 / 0.872). (3) THE SPLIT BETWEEN TIERED AND UNTIERED CONSTRUCTION — granular ran tiered 0.41x against everything-else 0.96x, a targeted collapse; if the multiplier works, the tiered share of construction should climb back off 4.96% toward canon's 11.03%. (4) The era mix of tiered construction: the quadratic at FULL size pulled e0 down but loaded e2/e3 rather than the top; does the same ladder on a 1/5 unit behave differently? (5) The below-best metric — ⚠ expected to say little by 1886, since its fault accumulates as chains lengthen and it was inside noise even at 1935; report it, do not lean on it.
_cost: 1 run x 50 in-game years. Measured on this machine and patch, 1836 -> 1880 is ~55 min and the rate declines through the span, so 1886 is ~65-70 min plus one build of ~8 s and the concurrent save harvest. Well inside the user's stated time budget.
_caveats: ⚠ n=1: no spread, and no variance statement. Defensible here ONLY because the effect being tested is 6-30x the measured run-to-run noise at every checkpoint (see _why_this_span_is_enough); it would not be defensible for a subtler question. ⚠ HALF SPAN: says nothing about 1886-1936, and in particular nothing about the late-era tiers (e4/e5 barely exist by 1886) or about any metric whose fault accumulates over a century. ⚠ The granular partner is 1.13.11 on this machine (clean); canon-n7 is 1.13.10 (patch caveat). Machine to stay idle — NO ANALYSIS WHILE THE GAME RUNS. building_inventory deliberately absent (log-ring overflow, L4/L9). Save harvest ON and concurrent: every metric above reads the yearly summaries. moderate_consolidation, verified from world.game_rules. L17: preflight.ps1 -Session post-run. L19: no orphaned victoria3.exe at launch.
